picks.title: What ClickUp's mass layoff tells us about the future of work
picks.why_it_matters: A major SaaS company replacing hundreds of employees with AI agents signals a fundamental shift in startup economics and headcount assumptions that will reshape how founders build and VCs model workforce-light companies.

picks.title: The pitch trick that helped an eSports startup raise $20M when VCs only wanted AI
picks.why_it_matters: A $20M raise in a non-AI vertical provides tactical insight into how founders are successfully navigating the current AI-dominated funding environment—useful intelligence for evaluating pitches from non-AI startups.

picks.title: CISA sidelined as White House scrambles on AI cyber threats
picks.why_it_matters: Government fragmentation on AI cybersecurity creates both market opportunity for startups filling the gap and regulatory uncertainty that could affect AI security and compliance-focused investments.
